newPlatforms.name: Airhug Radio Independent Artist Submission Form
newPlatforms.country: Global online independent-music radio; operator location is not explicitly published and the first-party site states a worldwide artist focus.
newPlatforms.submissionMethod: official first-party public four-step independent-artist submission form with direct audio and lyrics uploads

authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Submit independent music for possible non-interactive radio airplay, educational features, artist spotlights or licensing opportunities.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Open the official form, confirm track eligibility including the strict no-AI rule and registration prerequisites, review the linked terms and every consent, then upload and submit only after explicit owner approval.
authorizedRoute.internationalAcceptanceEvidence: The first-party About page states that Airhug Radio commits to independent artists globally and the form requests country of origin.
authorizedRoute.standardRouteFeeEvidence: No fee, checkout or payment step is published on the first-party submission form.

publishedRequirements: use the official four-step music-submission form
submit all responses in English
be an independent artist with less than fifty percent major-label ownership
have the music registered with a Performing Rights Organization
be registered with SoundExchange
provide artist or band name and legal name for royalty purposes
provide email address and country of origin
state label status and label name when applicable
provide song title and optional ISRC code
provide PRO membership, work ID and SoundExchange registration details
select genre and provide BPM
upload song files and lyrics
prefer WAV audio and provide lyrics as PDF
disclose explicit language and provide a clean version when available
provide a short artist biography
choose whether to be considered for an educational interview or artist spotlight
choose whether to permit use of artist photo and cover art for promotion
grant permission for non-interactive streaming broadcast
confirm authority to submit and agree to notify the station if rights or licensing status changes
agree to the linked Live365 non-interactive broadcast terms
type a full legal name as a digital signature and provide date/time
do not submit music using AI because AI use is strictly prohibited
formFieldsObserved: artist photo and cover-art promotional consent

verify lyrics PDF and all lyric, composition, master, sample and contributor rights
review promotional photo and cover-art consent and verify visual rights
review broadcast authorization and linked Live365 terms
inspect the live form for CAPTCHA, anti-spam, authentication, upload and payment controls
approve every personal-data field, consent, digital signature and final submission action

businessContact.emailStatus: No public business email was identified on the inspected first-party submission, home or about surfaces as an authorized music-submission route. The dedicated form is the only recorded route.
businessContact.verification: Email verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax and purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.captchaStatus: No CAPTCHA was visible in the passively rendered four-step form. The dedicated agent-browser runner was unavailable, so hidden or submit-time anti-spam controls remain unverified.
formBoundary.loginStatus: The form is publicly rendered and no account or login requirement is stated.
formBoundary.paymentStatus: No fee or payment control is published on the submission form.
formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: Human review is required for strict no-AI eligibility, PRO and SoundExchange prerequisites, legal identity and royalty data, direct uploads, promotional-media consent, broadcast authorization, linked terms, digital signature and any hidden live controls.
rightsOrConsentFields: permission to use artist photo and cover art for website and social-media promotion
permission to broadcast submitted tracks through the non-interactive streaming service
confirmation of authority to submit the music
agreement to notify Airhug Radio if ownership or licensing status changes
agreement to linked Live365 broadcast terms
typed full name as a digital signature
uploadControls: up to ten song and lyrics files
clean version requested when explicit language is present
adjacentRoutesExcluded: educational interview or artist-spotlight interest as a separate route
licensing opportunities without a separately published submission path

legalReview.publishedTermsStatus: The submission form links to Live365 Broadcaster Terms and Conditions. The passive fetch exposed only navigation and footer content rather than the substantive terms, so a human must inspect them before agreeing.
legalReview.publishedLicenseSummary: The first-party form states that the artist grants Airhug Radio permission to broadcast submitted tracks on its non-interactive streaming service while retaining copyright and ownership.

activityVerification.evidence: The first-party site is live with a current 2026 team and submission form. The linked Live365 station displayed a current now-playing track and multiple recently played entries measured in minutes during verification.

genreFitEvidence: The official form explicitly lists Electronic and World alongside Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, R&B, Country, Jazz, Blues, Folk, Classical and Latin.
The Live365 profile describes a genre-spanning independent-music station with emerging and under-the-radar artists.
Only a fully non-AI MarcsMusic track satisfying the platform's registration and rights requirements can be considered.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is active and globally oriented, but it requires direct uploads, legal and royalty information, PRO and SoundExchange prerequisites, promotional and broadcast consents, a digital signature and agreement to linked terms. The strict AI prohibition is a decisive eligibility gate for MarcsMusic and requires track-level human confirmation.

dedupeTerms: Airhug Radio Independent Artist Submission Form
deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete accessible open pull-request patch and repository code search were checked for the platform name and canonical domain and returned no match before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: The first-party four-step music-submission form is stored once as the canonical opportunity. General social links, Live365 broadcaster registration, interview interest and unspecific licensing references are not separate submission routes.

notes: One Airhug Radio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No form field was filled, no file was uploaded, no agreement was accepted, no signature was entered, no login was used, no CAPTCHA was solved and no payment or submission action was completed.
